quest.title: Finches Are Still the Cutest
quest.description: Somewhere in Atocpan, you and Paimon run into a cheerful researcher slash merchant slash expert on adorable creatures. She invites you to play a game...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4

dialogues.speaker: Basima the Fifth
dialogues.text: Chirp chirp! Coo coo! Chirp chirp chirp!

choices.text: Are you sending... some kind of secret message?

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Sort of! This is a technique I use to communicate with the cute little finches.

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Oh, I seem to have forgotten to say hello to you folks. And the all-important opening line.

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Kind Travelers passing through, I, Basima the Fifth, Amurta researcher, rising mercantile star, and expert on adorable animals, offer my heartfelt greetings.

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Please. Relax thy body, clear thy mind, and listen closely, for I have a matter of utmost importance to share with you—

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: You're absolutely correct! Congratulations, looks like the Finch's cuteness got to you too. You're even jumping to answer right away!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This is odd. Paimon's not sure why, but when she saw the game on the table, this line just popped into her head.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Does this feel familiar to you too, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: We've met this lady before, right?

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: You're right! And it wasn't just a brief encounter either. It warms my heart to see you both still so full of life!

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Anyway, would you like to try this game? This is version 17 from the third generation of "Bing-Bang Finchball!"

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: As you unwind and enjoy the game, you'll also get to hear wonderful stories of how the little finch, alongside the much, much bigger Ancient Scarlet-Plume Finch, triumphed over the gulls!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds awesome! We've always been huge fans of relaxing games!

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: Alright! I hope you find the way of playing that suits you best and enjoy a one-of-a-kind experience!

choices.text: We can start the "finches are the cutest" thing now, if you want.

response.speaker: Basima the Fifth
response.text: You got it! And even if you can't remember the past right now, that's fine. What matters is that you enjoy the present...

choices.text: Or speaking in some kind of... code?
